mentions.name: sei
mentions.description: A TUI written in Go for managing AI agent skills. It keeps a personal collection of agent skills in a dedicated git repository and copies individual skills into a project's .claude/skills/ directory for a session, then removes them when done, replacing manual ls, cp -r, and rm -rf commands with a few keystrokes.
mentions.problem: Juggling 20-30 agent skills in the .claude/skills/ directory and manually copying them in and out of projects with shell commands is tedious.
mentions.source_excerpt: Haven't added a demo to the repo yet (will do soon) but building this TUI [1] in Go to manage my agent skills.
mentions.author: primaprashant
